name: Microsoft OneNote
description: Microsoft OneNote is a digital note-taking app organized into notebooks, sections, and pages, supporting handwriting, voice transcription, and real-time collaboration so users can capture ideas and organize projects across devices.
best_for: Positioned for individuals and teams already in the Microsoft ecosystem who want free-form, notebook-style note-taking with handwriting and voice capture across all their devices.
features: Notebook, section, and page hierarchy for organizing notes
Handwriting and digital ink with stylus support for sketching and annotating
Voice transcription to capture notes from audio
Real-time collaboration for multiple users working on shared notebooks
Copilot in OneNote for drafting plans, generating ideas, and organizing information
Free version, with additional features included in Microsoft 365 subscriptions

alternatives.name: Evernote
alternatives.description: A note-taking app for capturing, organizing, and searching notes, documents, and web clippings.
alternatives.best_for: Users who want strong web clipping and document scanning

alternatives.name: Notion
alternatives.description: An all-in-one workspace combining documents, databases, project tracking, and team knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: Users who want structured databases alongside free-form notes

alternatives.name: Craft
alternatives.description: A notes and docs app with block-based editing, AI writing assistance, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Users who want a more design-focused, block-based notes app
